name: european_open_momentum_continuation_5s
author: adapted from Gemini Quant
thesis: Exploits the liquidity influx from the London/European market open (13:30 IST). Arbitrageurs and global macro funds trade ADR/GDR underlyings at this time, creating a directional 'push' in liquid Indian large-caps that persists until the US pre-market opens.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.
weaknesses: European macro events can trigger reversals
Reliance on global flows which can be absent on European holidays
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to BANKNIFTY index.
